newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Nizhnetagilsk plans new share issue.
newsitem.headline: Nizhnetagilsk plans new share issue.

text.p: The board of directors at Russian steel producer Nizhnetagilsk Metal has approved plans to issue new shares doubling capital to 2.07 trillion roubles ($359.7 million), a senior company official said on Monday.

Sergei Ivanov, head of the company's property department, told Reuters AO Nizhnetagilsky Metallurgichesky Kombinat (NTMK) would issue 1.03 billion ordinary shares with a face value of 1,000 roubles each.
"The money raised by placing the new issue of NTMK shares will be used to reconstruct the enterprise," he said.
The shares will be offered from July 1 this year to February 5, 1998, and are open to all potential investors, individual and corporate, foreign and Russian, he said.
NTMK was last traded on the Russian Trading System on Wednesday at $0.080.
